logic_audit.compact_nonrational_shell: For a visible normal every archimedean summand of the fixed trace norm is negative.  Compactness uniformly bounds the distinguished Lorentz boost; negative definiteness bounds the other embeddings; the Minkowski lattice then leaves finitely many shell vectors.
logic_audit.compression_discriminant_bound: Primitive T and K make the overlattice glue a graph.  Hence the subgroup generated by the projected facet classes injects into A_K, whose p-length is at most rank K.
logic_audit.exact_module_similarity: The contradiction uses one rational similarity and rational line representatives.  It does not apply after forgetting the pinned Q-module and retaining only the unlabelled real polytope.
logic_audit.generic_facet_root_necessity: A finite facet has a generic positive point.  Local finiteness of K3 root mirrors near that point makes one active root inequality support an open subset of the facet.  At rank saturation the projection is the identity, so the root lies on the raw Q-line.
logic_audit.rational_cusp_completeness: When s is divisible by each facet norm, the residue-shell identity makes y an integral reflection vector.  Completeness for every integral reflection of the pinned host makes its inequality old or redundant even at a cusp.

scope_verdict.not_proved: a counterexample restricted to absolutely maximal arithmetic reflection groups, or a no-go for unlabelled real/mixed-divisor K3 carriers
scope_verdict.proved: X3 disproves exact-module projected K3 eigen-nef universality over all finite-volume arithmetic chambers of trace rank at most 20.
